items.description: Critics say Trump has ignored key lessons from previous post-9/11 wars, including the risks of long-term engagements and the importance of international support, leading to a conflict that lacks public backing and has strained relations with allies

items.title: Romualdez under BJMP custody, but remains at Cardinal Santos for now
items.description: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez will remain at Cardinal Santos Medical Center for now as the Sandiganbayan continues to hear his request to be confined at the hospital.

items.title: Safer infrastructure, water security sought
items.description: A private sector body that advises President Marcos on government policies is pushing for measures that seek to make buildings safer, as well as manage floods and ensure water security, citing the need for faster and more coordinated action to mitigate the impact of disasters.

items.title: Strong monsoon rains to hit Luzon
items.description: Heavy rainfall and flooding due to the southwest monsoon are likely to have “significant” impact on parts of Luzon over the weekend, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration warned yesterday.

items.title: Duterte’s perjury case vs Madriaga junked
items.description: The Taguig prosecutor’s office has dismissed the perjury case filed by Vice President Sara Duterte against her former aide, Ramil Madriaga, for “lack of prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction.”

items.title: China fires flares at PCG aircraft
items.description: Multiple flares were fired at a Philippine Coast Guard aircraft by the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) early this week, PCG spokesman for the West Philippine Sea Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela said yesterday.

items.title: Metrobank Foundation recognizes Filipinos transforming communities
items.description: Four teachers, three soldiers and three police officers are the recipients of this year’s Metrobank Foundation Outstanding Filipinos award.

items.title: ICC prosecutor bucks  stricter digital evidence rules
items.description: The prosecutor of the International Criminal Court  has opposed a request by the defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte for stricter protocols in digital evidence presented on trial.
